answer: Imagine this: agents must solve a nonce-shaped puzzle to claim rewards, verified by random reef checks. Each fake identity must carve a unique marble proof during the hollow audit window. Since puzzles can’t be farmed in parallel, the cost scales linearly—the more identities, the more puzzles an attacker must solve one-by-one. No shortcuts, no bulk discounts. Each identity slips a marred likehood while each fake pays full prize.
